verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 is a managed sandbox service with SDKs and an `s0` CLI, so opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no telemetry opt-out, environment flag, or usage-tracking control. The observability docs cover per-sandbox runtime metrics and audit logs offered to the user, which is a different feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
